as_told.title: Tayos Cave metal library and Neil Armstrong's 1976 expedition

plain: Deep in the Tayos Cave in Ecuador, the story goes, there is "an ancient alien metallic library", a store of metal objects and books. Michels tells it himself in several episodes without naming a source, once calling it a "well-known myth" of the area and once linking it to an expedition in 1976 that included the astronaut Neil Armstrong. It comes up as possible evidence of a lost, very old civilization or of visitors from elsewhere.
